expectedIssues: Profile is highlighted in the bottom nav bar while the home feed is shown
reportedIssues: The bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' as the active tab, but the screen shown is the restaurant discovery/home feed. The active-state indicator does not match the content, so users are misled about where they are. 'Home' appears inactive.

Low-contrast text: the gray delivery-fee captions (e.g. '€0.90 delivery'), the search placeholder, and the inactive nav labels are light gray on a light background. The white-on-green promo subtext over the lighter circular overlay is also weaker.

The time badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the bottom-left edge of the image and sit close to the card corner. On the first card the white badge blends into the light image background.
The heart/favorite button on the dark food images has low contrast. It is a dark translucent circle over a dark photo, especially on the ramen card.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes Profile being active while the restaurant discovery/home feed is shown.
